latestVersion.changelog:
token-saver v0.1.0 (Initial release)

- Introduces waste detection for Claude API usage, identifying costly patterns in agent configs and workflows.
- Provides ranked, actionable cost-saving recommendations based on detected inefficiencies.
- Adds safe configuration editing: always shows diffs and prompts for confirmation before applying file changes.
- Offers quick, privacy-friendly cost reports using Anthropic usage data or local estimates.
- Documentation includes detailed step-by-step instructions and model configuration tips for maximum savings.
